scope: Read-only literature and existing local mass-formula review. Only this new independent research artifact is written; no production, assets, current config, run output, solver, trajectory or gate is changed.

references.title: Sylvie® 3D Drape Tester – New system for measuring fabric drape
references.source_type: Author-institution hosted experimental paper;15 measured fabrics
references.thickness_test_note: Table footnote: thickness under0.49cN/cm² pressure; a test-dependent fabric envelope, not solid fibre thickness.

bending_column_excluded_from_SI_comparis.reason: Per-unit-width normalization is not unambiguously stated in the table. It is not silently converted into N m or used to claim D=10µNm is calibrated.

references.supports: Measured cotton areal mass near190–200g/m² with thickness near the current0.6mm model envelope.
references.does_not_establish: No positive certification of an uncoated/unfinished sample or of the full current native constitutive profile.

references.title: Comfort and Handle Behaviour of Linen-Blended Fabrics
references.author: B.K.Behera

locations.testing_method: Section2.4: Kawabata evaluation system, KES-FB2 bending

references.finish_scope: Commercial singeing/degumming/bleaching/mercerization/dyeing/finishing are described; finishing chemistry is unspecified. No coating is described, but uncoated cannot be positively certified.
references.supports: One measured185gsm linen has B≈19.12µNm; the lighter144gsm cotton/linen blend has B≈9.71µNm. This brackets an order of magnitude, not a measured200gsm/10µNm pair.
references.verification_limit: Tables checked via PDF text extraction by parent and bounded independent reviewer; screenshot verification was unavailable and is not claimed.

references.title: Effect of Enzymatic Hydrolysis on the Measured Primary Hand Qualities of Cotton Fabrics

locations.test_fabric: Materials and Methods, printed p736/PDF p2

references.sample: 100% cotton plain-weave sheeting,56ends and56picks/inch; desized,scoured,bleached before enzyme experiment
references.test_scope: KES-F low-stress measurements; source directly gives B inµN m. Treated samples lost about4% mass; the165gsm specification describes the starting fabric, not an asserted unchanged treated mass.
references.supports: A measured lighter cotton fabric combines a porous thickness envelope near0.6–0.7mm with bending rigidity of order10µNm. No proof of matching present E,shear,friction or hysteresis.

current_model_mass_basis.density_interpretation: Effective porous fabric bulk density at the model thickness, not the intrinsic density of cellulose fibres.

single_candidate_if_separately_authorize.status: Literature-informed material hypothesis only; not applied or simulated by this review
single_candidate_if_separately_authorize.mass_readback_status: Derived using the native mass convention; no new200gsm native mass has been read back or claimed.
single_candidate_if_separately_authorize.selection_basis: The upper end of a measured plausible180–200gsm cotton/linen range, with a one-third mass reduction from300gsm. Not selected by fitting a rim-height or acceptance threshold.
single_candidate_if_separately_authorize.calibration_status: Not a matched measurement set from one physical fabric. In particular200gsm/10µNm is not the measured185gsm linen19.12µNm pair, and the retained E,shear/friction have not been identified from these references.

dimensional_effects.elastogravity_length_formula: (D/(areal_density*g))^(1/3), dimensional estimate rather than a bag-shape prediction
dimensional_effects.frequency_scope: Small-amplitude fixed-geometry scaling only, not a modal prediction for contact-driven folded cloth.

limits_and_required_claim_boundaries: No added damping. Lower mass does not increase physical damping or guarantee less recoil/rebound.
Areal mass is a physical material property; gravitational acceleration stays unchanged. Nevertheless mass reduction changes dynamics as well as static loading.
The approximately14.5% elastogravity-length increase does not predict a44–60mm rim-height recovery or any monotonic change in folded bag geometry.
Measured drape depends on weave,finishing,direction,bending/shear coupling,contact history and hysteresis. One scalarD plus isotropic membrane parameters cannot reproduce all these behaviours.
No native trial,planner,sweep,containment or final-success result for the200gsm candidate is established here.
Every original motion/geometry/teddy/force/J/stretch/table/grasp/final-containment/retention gate remains required; no accepted old cloth state is reused as a new actual state.
This is not positive proof of uncoated cotton/linen composition for the rendered sample, nor of inextensibility or calibrated friction.
